candidates.name: Cryoglobulinemia
support_spans: Rouleaux and cryoprotein precipitate on peripheral blood smear
Elevated serum cryoglobulin levels (cryocrit, 16%)
candidates.why: The patient has elevated serum cryoglobulin levels and cryoprotein precipitate on peripheral blood smear, which are characteristic of cryoglobulinemia.

candidates.name: Multiple Myeloma
support_spans: Abnormal paraprotein band on serum and urine protein electrophoreses
Monoclonal IgG-κ protein on immunofixation electrophoresis
Hypercellular marrow consisting of 80% plasma cells with atypical morphology and κ-light-chain restriction
candidates.why: The patient has an abnormal paraprotein band, monoclonal IgG-κ protein, and hypercellular marrow with plasma cell infiltration, which are characteristic of multiple myeloma.

candidates.name: Amyloidosis
support_spans: Multifocal intravascular fibrinoid material consisting of a mix of cryoglobulins and fibrin thrombi with relatively little vessel wall inflammation
candidates.why: The patient has intravascular fibrinoid material, which can be seen in amyloidosis, although the presence of cryoglobulins and fibrin thrombi suggests a more complex diagnosis.
